item.title: Grantham man, 55, named as police treat death as murder
item.description: Police have confirmed that the man who died following an incident in Greyfriars on Monday evening (26 January), was 55-year-old Ian Jackson-Winch, from Grantham. Police believe Ian was stabbed, and we are treating his death as murder.
